summary:
Behavioral Health Crisis Care Centers Act of 2025

This bill requires the Department of Health and Human Services to establish a grant program for states, Indian tribes, territories, and localities to support one-stop crisis facilities. These facilities provide behavioral health, substance use disorder, recovery, and related support services at a single location, as well as coordinate with other services available in the community.
